ov: Large semiaquatic rodents, the second-largest living rodents after capybaras. Beavers fell trees to build dams and lodges, and the ponds they make create wetlands for many other species.

why.et: Beavers have long been hunted for their fur, meat and castoreum, a scent-gland secretion once used in perfume, medicine and food flavouring.
why.ac: Mainly active at night and around dusk, spending the day in its lodge.

rg: North American beaver: most of the US and Canada, into northern Mexico. Eurasian beaver: much of Europe and western Russia, with small native groups in Mongolia and China.
df: Leaves, roots, grasses, sedges and water plants in summer; bark and the soft layer beneath it in autumn and winter.
fx: A beaver can fell a tree up to 15 cm wide in under 50 minutes.
notes: Two species. The existing fact (orange, iron-reinforced teeth) is confirmed: the enamel is coloured orange by iron compounds. REGION: animals.js r is North America and Europe.
